dedupe_keys.name: zarc brazil agricultural climate risk zoning mapa embrapa

description: Brazil's official zoning of climate risk for crops by municipality and planting date. The MAPA page says the ZARC programme, governed by Decree 9.841/2019, analyses climate, soil and cultivar cycle parameters with a method validated by Embrapa to quantify climate risks of crop loss, and publishes results as ordinances of the Secretariat of Agricultural Policy, by crop and state, listing the municipalities suitable for planting with their planting calendars. It was first published for wheat in 1996 and now covers all states and more than 40 crops; following it is required for Proagro and the rural insurance premium subsidy. The Embrapa page says it limits losses from drought, extreme temperatures and excess rain, built by 34 Embrapa units. The ordinances are free downloadable documents. Coverage is Brazil. Caveats: the licence is not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives municipal climate risk classes to test crop exposure to drought. A related catalogue record is Brazil Atlas do Seguro Rural.
